text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when everyone was practicing 
together for the upcoming live concert—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san. Were you able to get in 
touch with Hello-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon asks timidly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, messages from Light 
Hello had become far less frequent than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I'll be okay.
choice_data_list:
I think they might just be busy with work 
or something.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah...
choice_data_list: It's okay, don't worry about a thing.
It's okay, don't you all worry

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, may I ask you a question? It's 
regarding the lyrics and choreography.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup, sure! If you ask me, these lyrics 
mean—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that, but truthfully, I'm 
worried about Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, when I visited Light Hello's 
office—"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Thank you for your hard work. 
Were you able to tell everyone I'm okay, 
just like I messaged you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm... fine. I'm already drafting the next 
proposal, so...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I was just riding on their coattails... 
Even though everyone else worked so 
hard...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um... so it's fine. I'm fine, really...
choice_data_list: ...It doesn't look like that to me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
choice_data_list: Shall we have a little chat?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...I truly knew nothing at all about live 
concerts."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course they wouldn't. After all, 
I've always just been... ...a backup 
dancer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
For a while, people talked about me being 
the grandchild of a famous Umamusume, so 
there were some slight expectations when I 
came to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I was weak. I couldn't win at 
all. And I never even got to sing at a 
live show once.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And after all that, I still couldn't even 
thank the fans who supported me...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Without being able to tell my fans 
anything... That hurts more than anything 
else...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: That's why, to those girls—

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Saying anyone can just sing along is 
wrong! Please don't disregard all our hard 
work!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
That just makes it look like an excuse 
using the fans to run away from not being 
able to win...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...When you told me I was running away, I 
finally realized it."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the reason I was so desperate to 
revive the Grand Live was just because I 
wanted to run away.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Paraphrasing it so prettily, as if anyone 
can just convey their feelings of 
gratitude to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I wonder if in truth, I just 
wanted to be free from the bitter memories 
lingering in my heart.”

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I just assumed that having the Grand Live 
would take away all the regrets...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems ridiculous, doesn't it? 
Full-grown adults dragging children into 
their own egos..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'm truly, terribly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I look forward to working with 
you today as well.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Bourbon-chan is working hard today as 
always, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
They say, "Slack off for one day, and you 
lose three days' progress." I don't 
believe I can afford to slack off.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status: 『Restless』.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I see.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ms. Hello?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Speaking with you the other day, 
Trainer, helped me sort out my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me apologize to everyone. For 
dragging you all into the Grand Live plan.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I ended up imposing my own views on them. 
The Winning Live really should be a stage 
reserved for the victors.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Because for an Umamusume, winning is what 
matters most. A mistake that tramples all 
over that is—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A 'mistake'?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is the Grand Live plan really a "mistake"?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Playing back the arguments of the 
opposition. 'Our fans cheer for us because 
we're giving it our all and trying our 
absolute hardest.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I want to win and answer their 
cheers." Understood. That assertion is 
fully justified.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the first time I saw 
Falcon-san's performance for the Grand 
Live, however...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A "wish" was born within me. —To simply 
convey my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Also, another fan told me this: 'You 
convey entirely different feelings in your 
races compared to your lives.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I want to 'live up' to those feelings. 
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand on the Grand Live stage 
too. On a stage where everyone can gather 
all at once.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Because the stage has become a 'precious' 
place to me. If there's a place where I 
can convey my feelings, I want to be part 
of it."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Is this a "mistake"?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're not mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Because when I first heard about the 
Grand Live, I got super excited too!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I thought that with the Grand Live, we 
could definitely do things that just 
aren't possible in a Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Would it be better if Winning Lives 
just didn't have centers or back dancers 
at all?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Winning Lives shine so brightly 
because everyone competed with all their 
might. That's why everyone longs to stand 
at center stage...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I really thought this would make everyone 
smile...!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as they said, even if it all began 
from mere ego.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume felt something else drawing 
them toward the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: What... would that be?
choice_data_list:
It's 'Exploring the Potential of the Grand 
Live'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should be asking that of 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...At this rate, wouldn't our positions 
be reversed...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Light Hello and the others 
decided to give the "Grand Live" some more 
thought.
